notes: Arjuna in penance — no peacock in exile. Kirata = hunter disguise of Shiva; reveal is luminous not horror.

arjuna.face: Young warrior, thin dark mustache, focused calm, oval face
arjuna.hair: Black curly topknot — NO peacock feather during penance
arjuna.costume: Ascetic or simple cream dhoti for penance; bow and quiver when fighting

kirata.face: Rugged mountain hunter, strong jaw, fierce eyes, dark skin tone comic style
kirata.hair: Wild dark hair or simple hunter topknot
kirata.costume: Leaf-and-hide hunter dress, bow, mountain simplicity — still charming comic not photoreal

shiva.face: Divine serene fierce beauty, third eye optional soft glow, calm smile of blessing
shiva.hair: Jata matted locks with crescent moon, Ganga soft stream optional
shiva.costume: Tiger skin or white ash, rudraksha, trident, luminous gold-cream aura

boar.face: Stylized wild boar, fierce comic mythology
